title: More control over images and video in Chat
summary:
Chat gained image and video controls, Claude image URL inputs got a fix, and a Discord companion joined the project directory.

Chat gained a Generation Options modal for image dimensions, seed and quality, plus video seed, duration, aspect ratio and audio. Those settings are passed to generation requests. Image generation now defaults to 1024×1024 with enhancement off; Chat also routes generation and model requests through gen.pollinations.ai and recovers when a saved active chat no longer exists.

Claude requests routed through Bedrock now convert HTTP image URLs to base64 data URLs, fixing image URL input on `/v1/chat/completions`. The existing Vertex AI conversion remains unchanged.

Lily – AI Discord Companion was added to the socialBots project directory with an install link. Its listing describes a bot that remembers user facts and relationships, responds to emotional tone, and decides when to join a conversation.

highlights.title: Chat generation controls
highlights.text: Set image dimensions, seed and quality, or adjust video duration, aspect ratio and audio from Chat's new Generation Options modal. [Open Chat](https://chat.pollinations.ai).
